label: sec:wenzl-bridge-cyclotomic-lr-tensor-character-preamble
html: We now construct the Littlewood-Richardson tensor character bridge. We use the Wenzl-Q_{mn} synergy to pin the substrate-flow evaluations. We extract explicit \alpha_k values at h = 3 and h = 4. We outline the Wedderburn-Bratteli recursion that supplies the substrate-flow data. Finally, we analyse the y_\lambda sign pattern and identify the higher-operation extensions.
